# APW attribution

Aster's browser transport and extension bridge are adapted from [Apple Passwords CLI (APW)](https://github.com/bendews/apw) 1.1.1 by bendews and contributors.

Source commit: `7b2f157ef1a46e15320fe97b1a75073d791a6eec`.

Aster adds a private browser profile, app-controlled pairing, session cleanup, and serialized credential requests. The derived code is licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later. The full GPL version 3 text is included with Aster and in `Vendor/APW/LICENSE` in the source tree.
